static_traits.name: Li Jie
static_traits.family_status: Father passed away when she was 2, other family situation Not mentioned
static_traits.social_status: Relationship tension with friends and family from avoiding crowded places; social life affected
static_traits.medical_history: Not yet received psychotherapy or psychological problem treatment; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, high cooperativeness; able to describe physiological and emotional reactions concretely (racing heart, whole-body tension, emotional overwhelm and irritability); Positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: Struggling to enjoy her favorite season (spring) because of crowds, feeling restless and uncomfortable in crowded places, Rising stress, gradually developing into active avoidance, affecting social life and causing Sense of isolation.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeking counseling because avoiding crowds markedly affects my social life and overall well-being, hoping to find ways to reduce Anxiety in crowded settings and enjoy spring again.
growth_experiences: Father passed away when she was 2 (early bereavement), subsequent growth details Not mentioned.

core_beliefs: The world (crowds) is not safe, bad things may happen at any time
In crowded settings I cannot control the situation, will be trapped or lose control
If others see me Anxious, they will look down on me

special_situations.event: Encounters crowds at public events or busy parks in spring
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the venue is very crowded, I may be unable to leave quickly, things will get bad
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to avoid peak hours or simply not going to crowded places; leaving quickly once feeling crowded
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I might get trapped; something bad will happen

special_situations.event: Many people and noise at Social gatherings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others see me Anxious, they will despise me, thinking I am terrible
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Proactively Avoiding socializing activities to reduce exposure to others' evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will definitely notice I am nervous and look down on me

special_situations.event: Before a spring outing approaches, thinking of possibly encountering crowded crowds
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Whenever there are crowds, I definitely cannot relax or enjoy
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Canceling outings or social plans, turning to Being alone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Every time I encounter crowds I get unbearably Anxious

special_situations.event: In the spring park, only notices how many people are around
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: In crowded situations, positive experiences (flowers, weather, renewal) do not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding discomfort with Distraction or quick leaving
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Too many people, these beautiful things cannot make me enjoy

core_conflict.wish: Longing to feel safe, at ease, and accepted in spring and Social situations, able to freely enjoy beautiful experiences
core_conflict.fear: Fearing bad things happening in crowds, fearing being unable to escape and losing control, fearing being noticed and despised by others
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of safety and decency by avoiding crowded places, reduces the risk of being judged and losing control

object_relations.self_representation: A vulnerable person prone to Anxiety and losing control in crowded settings
object_relations.object_representation: Others/crowds are critical judges and potential sources of danger

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When in crowded public events or Social gatherings, or anticipating entering crowded occasions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Experiencing crowds as potential danger, and believing bystanders will notice and belittle her (transference: Projecting inner criticism onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Quickly finding exits, shortening stays or directly avoiding; verbally emphasizing others will look down on her, tense tone, brief, avoiding eye contact.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When considering attending spring outings or friends' gatherings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equating crowdedness with inability to relax and loss of control, treating leaving or not attending as the only reasonable choice
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Rationalizing canceling or withdrawing, e.g. 'I cannot relax with so many people', calm but firm tone, emphasizing efficiency and Self-protection.

manifestations: Reduced socializing participation from long avoiding crowded places, not yet talking about crowd discomfort with friends, feeling isolated
outcomes: Social withdrawal and Intensified sense of isolation
Anxiety markedly rising in crowded settings

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept in themselves to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language expressions include: 'He is looking down on me' and 'They want to exclude me'.
manifestations: Worrying others notice her Anxiety and despise her
In social settings, presumes negative evaluation from others and thus avoids participating

exception_events.target_problem: In public events or Social gatherings, the client usually gets strongly Anxious and hurries to leave, Difficulty relaxing and enjoying, then avoids such occasions.
exception_events.unique_outcome: At a smaller concert last year, although there were many people, the client accompanied a close friend and focused on the music, maintained relative calm, and also enjoyed the performance.
exception_events.reason: Different situation and support: having friends along enhances safety; music providing focusable positive stimulation; smaller sessions, relatively controllable environment, helping reduce attention to crowds and tension.

positive_force: Having emotional support from a few friends (though not yet discussing crowd discomfort, can have Average exchanges)
Was once able to maintain relative calm in crowded environments by focusing on music (an attention-regulation resource that can be used)
Proactively seeks counseling with a positive attitude, willing to try strategies (planning travel in off-peak periods, a gratitude journal)
negative_force: Catastrophic predictions and overgeneralization about crowded scenes
Mind-reading others' negative evaluations and negating positive experiences (mental filtering and negating the positive)
Long avoidance leading to limited social life and Intensified sense of isolation
Strong worry about being unable to leave quickly triggering loss of control

target_behavior.behavior: Significant anxiety and active avoidance in crowded places
antecedent: Encountering crowds in parks or outdoor activities in spring
Anticipating situations of entering crowded places
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic predictions about crowded situations (worrying bad things will happen, unable to escape) and worry about others' evaluations (believing others will despise her), leading to loss of control and high vigilance.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding unwelcome stimuli (sense of danger, worry about being judged, and strong Anxiety), to gain safety and control.
target_behavior.consequence: Going out and socializing less, unable to enjoy spring's positive experiences, Relationship tension and Sense of isolation.
